limitations: The classification applies only to finite commutative target semigroups and allows the ambient Brandt structure group to vary. It does not decide divisibility for arbitrary noncommutative semigroups, prescribe the structure group, or minimize its order.
scientific_integrity: A complete symbolic proof is included, supported by bounded exhaustive finite checks. Priority comparisons are best knowledge rather than exhaustive certification; independent audit has not been performed.
title: Commutative Brandt divisors coincide with embeddings, with the sharp matrix index
